title: "When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, kill a gear" payoff can never fire
expected: Card def /root/src/tcg/tcg-engines/packages/riftbound-cards/src/cards/sfd/zaun-punk.ts:4-16 has no hand-authored `abilities`, so enrich-cards.ts:29 runs parseAbilities on the rulesText. Verified by running the parser/getAllCards(): the enriched sfd-160-221 carries ONLY `{type:"triggered", trigger:{event:"play-self"}, condition:{type:"paid-additional-cost"}, effect:{type:"kill", target:{type:"gear"}}}` — the sentence "You may kill a friendly gear as an additional cost to play me." fails to parse (parseAbilities returns success:false for it alone) and yields no additional-cost ability. Consequently getOptionalPlayCost (riftbound-engine/src/game-definition/moves/play/cost.ts:909-1024) returns undefined for this card, playUnit's enumerator never emits a paidAdditionalCost/sacrificeId variant, the reducer fires play-self with paidAdditionalCost=false (play-unit.ts:1110, 1207), and trigger-runner.ts:289-293 gates the payoff on event.paidAdditionalCost===true, so the kill-a-gear trigger can never go on the chain. Engine plumbing works when the cost ability exists (rules-audit/optional-play-cost.test.ts:209 hand-authors `{type:"static", cost:{kill:{controller:"friendly",type:"gear"}}}`), confirming this is a card-layer gap: the payoff is unreachable because the real card lacks the additional-cost ability.
observed: No chain item / pendingChoice after play; both gears remained. Unreachable because the additional cost cannot be paid (see bug 1).
